description: This Java class 'LiveSignalEnforcement' manages enforcement of live signals, including commands and events, in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles authorization, publishing, and enforcement logic for messaging, streaming signals, and live commands/events.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement
classes.description: Enforces live commands (including message commands) and live events, providing authorization and publication mechanisms within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: LiveSignalEnforcement.Provider
classes.description: Provides instances of LiveSignalEnforcement configured with caches and pub/sub components for specific enforcement contexts.

methods.name: enforce
methods.description: Main enforcement method that processes a live signal, performs authorization, and dispatches it accordingly.

methods.name: doEnforce
methods.description: Performs enforcement logic on a given signal and enforcer entry, including handling different signal types.

methods.name: enforceLiveCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles enforcement of command response signals, routing them to the correct actor based on correlation ID.

methods.name: enforceLiveSignal
methods.description: Enforces live signals based on streaming type, including message commands and events.

methods.name: enforceLiveEvent
methods.description: Performs authorization checks and publishes live events if permitted.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Static method to determine if a signal is a live signal based on its type.

methods.name: enforceMessageCommand
methods.description: Enforces message commands, verifying authorization before publication.

methods.name: publishMessageCommand
methods.description: Publishes message commands after augmenting headers with read permissions.

methods.name: rejectMessageCommand
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating message command rejection due to insufficient rights.

methods.name: publishLiveSignal
methods.description: Publishes signals via pub/sub mechanism, wrapping for publication and potentiallyadding response receiver info.

methods.name: addToResponseReceiver
methods.description: Registers a response receiver for signals requiring responses, preventing duplicate correlation IDs.

methods.name: setUniqueCorrelationIdForGlobalDispatching
methods.description: Assigns a unique correlation ID to a signal, ensuring global dispatching integrity.

methods.name: findUniqueCorrelationId
methods.description: Recursively finds a unique correlation ID not already registered in the cache.
